mapper.select: SELECT id, title, link, icon, color, channel, module, resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, is_top AS isTop, create_time AS createTime FROM osh_announcement WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND status in (0,2,4) AND channel = #{channel} AND (start_time IS NULL OR start_time <= NOW()) AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= NOW()) ORDER BY is_top DESC, sort DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ranked.id, ranked.title, ranked.link, ranked.icon, ranked.color, ranked.channel, ranked.module, ranked.resourceType, ranked.resourceId, ranked.startTime, ranked.endTime, ranked.isTop, ranked.createTime FROM ( SELECT id, title, link, icon, color, channel, module, resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, is_top AS isTop, create_time AS createTime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY resource_type ORDER BY is_top DESC, sort DESC, create_time DESC ) AS row_num FROM osh_announcement WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND status in (0,2,4) AND module = 'homepage' AND channel = #{channel} AND resource_type IS NOT NULL AND resource_type != '' AND (start_time IS NULL OR start_time <= NOW()) AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= NOW()) ) ranked WHERE ranked.row_num <= #{limitPerType} ORDER BY ranked.resourceType ASC, ranked.isTop DESC, ranked.createTime DESC
